Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a new surcharge on certain recorded documents for preservation of local archive documents and the Washington state heritage center.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a new surcharge on certain recorded documentsfor preservation of local archive documents and the Washington stateheritage center; and adding a new section to chapter 36.22 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.22 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The county auditor shall charge a surcharge of twentyseven dollarsfor each document recorded, which is in addition to any other chargeallowed by law. The surcharge in this section applies only toassignments or substitutions of previously recorded deeds of trust.The funds collected under this section must be transmitted monthly tothe state treasurer who shall deposit sixtyseven percent of the fundsin the Washington state heritage center account created in RCW43.07.129 and thirtythree percent of the funds in the local governmentarchives account created in RCW 40.14.024.
